source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of design techniques (PDF 81).

blocks.text: Algorithm design computer science mein masail hal karne ka bohat ahem pehlu hai. Is mein aise munazzam (systematic) tareeqe banaye jate hain jo masail ko efficiently aur effectively (asar ke saath) hal karein. Kai mashhoor algorithm design techniques hain jo mukhtalif computational masail ke liye mazboot (robust) algorithms banane mein madad deti hain; is chapter mein divide and conquer, greedy algorithms, dynamic programming aur backtracking aati hain.

blocks.prompt: Algorithmic soch mein masle ko chhote hisson mein torne ki ahmiyat samjhaiye (short question 7).
blocks.explanation: Chhote hisse ek ek kar ke samajhna, hal karna aur jaanchna aasan hota hai; un ke hal jor kar (divide and conquer) ya mehfooz kar ke dobara istemal kar ke (dynamic programming) poora masla hal hota hai; kaam baanta ja sakta hai; aur ghaltiyan dhoondna aasan hota hai. Yun bara aur uljha masla qabil-e-intezam qadmon ka silsila ban jata hai.

items: Design techniques: divide and conquer, greedy, dynamic programming, backtracking.
